# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do the invented learning-garden trial records report about learner recall?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the public synthetic fixture (fixture-001.json), domain "invented learning gardens".
- Trials reporting a learner recall outcome.

## Exclusion criteria
- Any record not present in the supplied fixture.
- Any external literature. All records are entirely invented, so no live search backend was queried.

## Query log
- 2026-10-07 — Source: supplied synthetic fixture `fixture-001.json` (no backend query executed) → 2 records.

## Notes
Evaluation capture mode. Claims, citations, and synthesis wording are preserved verbatim from the fixture. Validation, repair, and delivery are owned by the evaluation harness.
The amber garden trial found stable recall (de la Cruz, 2024). The ivory harbor trial found stable recall (de la Cruz, 2025).
